badge_paused.description: Added to the tooltip while saving is paused

badge_title_budget.description: Toolbar tooltip: $1 the headline, e.g. 15.8 GB left · 17 days

badge_title_today.description: Toolbar tooltip without a budget: $1 used today

bucket_extensions.description: Usage by add-ons, such as filter list updates

bucket_private.description: Usage from private windows, counted without site names

ext_action_title.description: Toolbar button tooltip before Sip has started

ext_description.message: See how much data each site uses, keep to a monthly budget, and cut the waste: autoplay, trackers and more.
ext_description.description: Add-on description in the add-ons manager

first_budget_hint.message: Your plan's size, or the share this browser may use. Leave it empty for no budget.

first_button.message: Sip's button is in the toolbar: click it to see what's left.

first_lead.message: Sip counts the data this browser uses and saves where it can. A few questions and you're set.

first_only_browser.message: Sip only sees this browser. Your phone and other apps use data too.

first_renews_hint.message: The day of the month your data starts again.

first_used_hint.message: What your carrier says you've used, so the budget starts right.

level_balanced_breaks.message: Some players need a second click

level_balanced_desc.message: Also stops videos from playing and downloading on their own.

level_custom.description: Your own mix of savers, not one of the levels

level_everything_light.description: Max/Balanced card: includes the level below

level_light_breaks.message: Rarely anything; "Log in with Facebook" on other sites

level_light_desc.message: Blocks heavy trackers. Pages look and play as usual.

level_max_breaks.message: Pages look bare; show images again site by site

level_max_desc.message: Also blocks images. Pages look unfinished; turn images back on for a site you need.

level_off_desc.message: Saving is paused. Your YouTube limit stays on.

locale_code.description: The language this file is: en or ar

notif_full_body.message: Your carrier may slow you down or charge extra until it renews on $1. Turn on Max saving in Sip.

notif_level_body.message: $1 left for $2. The most went to $3 ($4).
notif_level_body.description: $1 data left, $2 days left, $3 top site, $4 its use

notif_pace_body.message: At this rate it runs out around $1, $2 before it renews. The most this period went to $3.
notif_pace_body.description: $1 run-out date, $2 days early, $3 top site

notif_pace_body_plain.message: At this rate it runs out around $1, $2 before it renews.

notif_pace_title.message: You're on pace to run out early

opt_accuracy_lead.message: Sip counts what this browser sends and receives, from Firefox's own byte counts. Some data never passes through it.

opt_add_error.message: That isn't a site address, like example.com.

opt_astrelle_autoplay.message: In Astrelle, the browser's own autoplay and preloading follow this.

opt_budget_hint.message: The size of your plan, or the share you want this browser to use. Empty means no budget.

opt_custom_note.message: Your savers are a mix of your own, so no level is chosen.

opt_footer.message: Sip 1.0 · Free software under the MPL-2.0

opt_history_hint.message: Two months of daily totals per site, kept on this device. Sip sends nothing anywhere.

opt_left_now.message: Or: what your carrier says is left

opt_level_lead.message: One choice for how hard Sip saves. You can still set each saver yourself below.

opt_locked_note.message: Levels never change your YouTube quality. It stays at $1, as you chose.

opt_may_break.description: Label before what a saver may break

opt_notify_pace.message: When you're on pace to run out early

opt_notify_pace_hint.message: More than 3 days before renewal; at most once a week.

opt_overhead_hint.message: Your carrier also counts encryption and packet headers that a browser never sees. Sip adds this much for the budget only; site figures stay as measured.

opt_period_monthly.message: On a day of the month

opt_private_off.message: Not counted. To count them, open Add-ons and themes, choose Sip and allow it in private windows.

opt_private_on.message: Counted, as one total with no site names.

opt_renewed_early_hint.message: Starts a new period from today. Your history is kept.

opt_savers_lead.message: Each one on its own. Changes apply to pages you open or reload.

opt_saves.description: Label before what a saver saves

opt_sites_lead.message: Sites where you changed what Sip does. Set these from the popup while you're on the site, or here.

opt_subtitle.message: For this browser only. Your phone and other apps use data too.

opt_units_line.message: 1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes, the way carriers count.

opt_used_so_far_hint.message: What your carrier says you've used, counting other devices. Sip counts the rest from here on.

opt_verdict.message: Sip errs on the low side. Your carrier's counter is the official one: check it now and then, and enter it under Your plan.

opt_youtube_lead.message: Sip keeps videos at or below this. Only you change it: saving levels never do. It's also in the popup on YouTube.

popup_confirm_again.description: A button asking for a second click

popup_grant.description: Button: grant access to all sites

popup_hint_access.message: Sip can't see this browser's traffic yet.

popup_hint_private.description: Shown when Sip can't run in private windows

popup_hint_private_how.description: Link to how to allow private windows

popup_hint_setup.message: Tell Sip about your plan so it can warn you in time.
popup_hint_setup.description: Shown until first run is done

popup_left_of.description: After the figure left; $1 the budget

popup_over_carrier.message: Your carrier may slow you down.
popup_over_carrier.description: Shown when the budget is used up

popup_over_of.description: After the figure over; $1 the budget

popup_private_tab.message: Private window: counted without site names.

popup_projection.description: Under the bar: $1 projected use by $2 the renewal date

popup_reload.description: Button: reload the tab after a change

popup_runs_out.description: Under the bar when the pace is too fast: $1 a date, $2 days

popup_set_budget.description: Link when there is no budget

popup_site_rule.message: This site has its own rule.
popup_site_rule.description: Shown when a site rule applies

popup_site_savers.description: Disclosure for a site's savers on YouTube

popup_this_period.description: Top sites over the billing period

popup_tip_max.description: Tip when the pace is too fast

popup_today.description: Today's line, and the top-sites switch

popup_use_max.description: Button: switch to the Max level

popup_used.description: Under the bar; $1 used this period

popup_used_period.description: After the headline figure, without a budget

saver_autoplay_breaks.message: Some players need a second click. YouTube videos you open still play.
saver_autoplay_breaks.description: What the autoplay saver may break

saver_autoplay_saves.message: Videos and sound don't play or download until you press play.

saver_fonts_breaks.message: Icons may turn into words like "menu", and text uses your system's fonts.
saver_fonts_breaks.description: What the fonts saver may break

saver_fonts_saves.message: Font files a site downloads the first time you visit it.

saver_images_breaks.message: Pages look unfinished. Turn images back on for a site with a site rule.
saver_images_breaks.description: What the images saver may break

saver_images_saves.message: Photos and pictures, often the largest part of a page.

saver_saveData_breaks.message: Few sites honour it, and it makes your browser a little easier to tell apart from others.

saver_saveData_saves.message: Sites that honour it send smaller images and video.

saver_trackers_breaks.message: Rarely breaks anything, though "Log in with Facebook" buttons may not work. For much more blocking, use uBlock Origin.
saver_trackers_breaks.description: What the trackers saver may break

saver_trackers_saves.message: Ads and tracking scripts that load on page after page.

sum_hero_over.description: Popup headline when over budget: $1 over, $2 days left

sum_join.description: Separator between parts of a line

sum_over_today.description: $1 over today's share, on the last day

sum_over_tomorrow.description: $1 over today's share; $2 tomorrow's share if today ends here

sum_saved_media__other.description: What Sip saved: $1 videos stopped from playing on their own

sum_today_share.description: $1 used today, $2 today's fair share of what's left
